harness: qualification/harness (committed; reproduces this packet, see its README.md)

sourceTreeDigests.construction: qualification/harness/source_digest.py over a fresh git archive extraction of each pinned revision; enforced fail-closed by the runner (exit 4 on mismatch), verified by a red negative control

runtime.device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU
runtime.networkIsolationProbe: huggingface.co DNS resolution failed inside the container, verified by the runner before any stage

verification.contractSchemaBreakdown: 7 trainer documents + 7 validator documents, each against its ml-worker schema at the pinned contract revision
verification.evidenceDigestConstruction: SHA-256 of UTF-8 sorted lines '<relative-path>  <file-sha256>\n' over the smoke root (pinned source archives + committed harness + all run outputs)

limitations: Bounded Tiny end-to-end fixture smoke, not a production-scale convergence or throughput benchmark.
Runtime qualification and VRAM envelopes remain recorded in blackwell-timm-1.0.28.json; this packet did not remeasure them.
Binding digests (worker release, job spec, admission, grant) are synthetic smoke values derived in the harness, not platform-issued records.
Training is REEXECUTABLE, not bitwise-deterministic: a rerun reproduced accuracy 1.0 with train loss differing in the 7th decimal and a different artifact bundle digest.
